interest: Index on 1931-33 Tokyo stock-market shocks from political crises.
overview: Docket cross-references 1931 and 1933 Tokyo Stock Exchange crises tied to the Mukden Incident and League withdrawal.

subfiles.about: A Department of State list of papers cross-referencing diplomatic despatches and periodic reports regarding Japanese stock market suspensions and crashes in 1931 and 1933.
subfiles.summary: Docket cross-references the 1931 Tokyo Exchange closure after Mukden, and the 1933 crash that erased 500 million yen.
